entities.summary: Marino Sinibaldi is an Italian journalist and literary critic. He hosted radio programs on the National Public Radio Tre, where he was author and conductor of Fahrenheit and assistant director of Radio Rai programs. On the 3rd of August 2009, Marino Sinibaldi was appointed director of RadioTre.
